First, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $z$, treating $x$ and $y$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{-1}^{2}{\int }_{0}^{1}{x}^{2}y+x{z}^{2}\,dz\,dx\,dy & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{-1}^{2}[{\int }_{0}^{1}{x}^{2}y+x{z}^{2}\,dz]dx\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{-1}^{2}{[{x}^{2}yz+\frac{x{z}^{3}}{3}]}_{z=0}^{z=1}\,dx\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{-1}^{2}{x}^{2}y(1-0)+x(\frac{1}{3}-0)\,dx\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{-1}^{2}{x}^{2}y+\frac{1}{3}x\,dx\,dy\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $x$, treating $y$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}{\int }_{-1}^{2}{x}^{2}y+\frac{1}{3}x\,dx\,dy & ={\int }_{1}^{2}[{\int }_{-1}^{2}{x}^{2}y+\frac{1}{3}x\,dx]dy \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}{[\frac{1}{3}{x}^{3}y+\frac{1}{6}{x}^{2}]}_{x=-1}^{x=2}\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}\frac{1}{3}y({2}^{3}-(-1)^{3})+\frac{1}{6}({2}^{2}-(-1)^{2}))\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{1}^{2}3y+\frac{1}{2}\,dy\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $y{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1}^{2}3y+\frac{1}{2}\,dx & ={[\frac{3{y}^{2}}{2}+\frac{y}{2}]}_{y=1}^{y=2} \\  & =(6+1)-(\frac{3}{2}+\frac{1}{2}) \\  & =5\end{aligned}
$$
